name: Rev. Solomon Matovu
short: Rev. Solomon Matovu is a clergy member of Namirembe Diocese serving as the Assistant Vicar of Luzira Parish at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira. Ordained on 8th December 2024, he is dedicated to preaching God's Word, pastoral care, discipleship, and nurturing a Christ-centred congregation.
facts: Diploma in Theology; Bachelor's Degree in Industrial and Organisational Psychology, Makerere University
Coordinator of Sunday School Ministry & Fathers' Union
Married to Mrs. Edith Matovu with three children
bio: About & Ministry Journey: Rev. Solomon Matovu is a clergy member of Namirembe Diocese, currently serving as the Assistant Vicar of Luzira Parish. His journey of faith began during his secondary school years when he gave his life to Jesus Christ while serving as a drummer in the Scripture Union at Progressive Citizens High School, Mukono. He later joined the choir at his home church, St. James Bukasa C.O.U., where church lay readers nurtured his spiritual growth, and went on to serve as Youth Chairperson and Mission Coordinator before undertaking three years of theological training. Prior to his current appointment, he served as a Church Curate supporting the Assistant Vicar of Luzira Parish. Ordained on 8th December 2024, he began serving at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira on 28th December 2024, assisting the Parish Vicar in priestly duties preaching, leading prayer services, administering baptism, and assisting in Holy Eucharist while also serving as Coordinator of the Sunday School Ministry and Coordinator of the Fathers' Union.

Education & Formation: Rev. Solomon holds a Diploma in Theology and a Bachelor's Degree in Industrial and Organisational Psychology from Makerere University. His educational journey includes Ebenezer Integrated Primary School (Kirinya), Progressive Citizens High School (Mukono), Namagunga High School, and Makerere University.

Ministry Focus & Reflections: Passionate about seeing individuals transformed into committed followers of Jesus Christ, his ministry focuses on preaching and teaching God's Word, discipleship and spiritual formation, evangelism and missions, youth and children's ministry, pastoral care and counselling, and worship and music ministry. Serving at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira an Archdeaconry Headquarters under the guidance of the Archdeacon, he emphasizes treating all Christians equally without bias and caring for both their spiritual and personal needs. His prayer is for a united congregation growing in faith, love, and service.

Scripture & Inspiration: His favourite Scripture is Hebrews 12:2 (KJV)"Looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith"alongside Acts 17:28, reflecting that his life and purpose are founded entirely in Christ. His personal guiding principle is: "I confidently know that Christ lives; therefore, I will face my tomorrow."

Beyond the Pulpit: Rev. Solomon is married to Mrs. Edith Matovu and is a father of three children. Outside ministry, he is passionate about farming, enjoys playing and watching football and volleyball, visits relatives and friends, and loves going on walks and adventurous travels with his family.

Message to the Congregation: "I encourage every member to remain in God's presence, love one another, love the ministry and treasure the privilege of dwelling in the house of the Lord. There are countless blessings in obeying God and living a life worthy of the calling we have received. Let us continue to walk together in faith, unity and love, faithfully serving the Lord in all that we do. May God bless St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira and make us a congregation that is continually growing in Christ and transforming lives for His glory."

name: Mub. Julius Kinene
short: Mub. Julius Kinene is a commissioned Lay Reader at St. Stephen's Church of Uganda, Luzira, serving with a deep commitment to sound biblical teaching and Christian discipleship. Commissioned on 8th December 2024, he coordinates multiple parish and archdeaconry ministries to build spiritually mature believers.
facts: Certificate in Christian Ministries; Diploma in Child Development and Children's Ministry, Uganda Christian University
Chairperson of Lay Readers (Luzira Archdeaconry); Member of Namirembe Diocesan Synod & Council; Coordinator of Good Samaritan, CWF, CMF, Youth, and Boys & Girls Brigade
Married to Mrs. Sandra Kinene with three children
bio: About & Ministry Journey: Mub. Julius Kinene is a commissioned Lay Reader at St. Stephen's Church of Uganda, Luzira. Having accepted Jesus Christ as Lord and Saviour on 4th November 2004, his faith journey was shaped by resilience and discipline through early personal and educational challenges. Before joining St. Stephen's, he served as Secretary of the Brotherhood of St. Andrews in Mukono Diocese, Youth Chairperson of St. Luke's C.O.U. Seeta, Chairperson of the Anointed Worship Team, and Chaplain of Kampala International University. After completing a block placement at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira in October 2022, he was commissioned as a Lay Reader on 8th December 2024 and officially posted to St. Stephen's. Alongside assisting clergy in liturgical, pastoral, evangelism, and discipleship duties, he serves as Coordinator of the Good Samaritan Ministry, Christian Women's Fellowship, Christian Men's Fellowship, and Youth Department (at Sub-parish and Parish levels), Coordinator of the Boys and Girls Brigade (Luzira Archdeaconry), Chairperson of the Lay Readers (Luzira Archdeaconry), and Member of both the Namirembe Diocesan Synod and Diocesan Council.

Education & Formation: Mub. Julius holds a Certificate in Christian Ministries (2022–2023) and a Diploma in Child Development and Children's Ministry (2021–2024) from Uganda Christian University, as well as additional certifications in Graphic Designing and Personal Effectiveness and Enterprise Development. His earlier schooling includes Naminya UMEA Primary School (PLE, 2001–2003), St. Cyprian High School, Kyabakadde (UCE, 2004–2008), and Bishop's Senior School, Mukono (UACE, 2009–2010).

Ministry Focus & Reflections: Deeply committed to sound biblical teaching and Christian doctrine, Mub. Julius places strong emphasis on baptism and confirmation preparation classes so believers are spiritually grounded. His ministry interests span preaching, discipleship, evangelism, youth and children's ministry, family and marriage ministry, pastoral care, community development, worship and music, and leadership development. Having witnessed how requiring baptism preparation classes transformed the congregation's seriousness toward the sacrament, he prays for a unified, spiritually vibrant Church working together in harmony.

Scripture & Inspiration: His favourite Scripture is Isaiah 6:1 (KJV)"In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple" reminding him that ministry begins with surrendering to God in His holiness. His personal guiding principle is: "Faith lived out in action, bringing Christ closer to His people, for the glory of God and the transformation of lives."

Beyond the Pulpit: Julius is a devoted husband to Mrs. Sandra Kinene and a father of three children, and is the last born in a family of three. Outside church duties, he enjoys reading, biblical studies, football, athletics, and family time, and engages in graphic design, printing, and creative media for church and community projects alongside personal and enterprise development.

Message to the Congregation: "Dear members of St. Stephen's Church of Uganda, Luzira, may we never lose our thirst and hunger for God and our love for His Son, Jesus Christ. May He unite us as one family, strengthen every department to work together in harmony and give each one of us a heart that is willing to serve. May our faith never remain in words alone, but be demonstrated through our love, unity and care for one another. Let us continue to grow in the knowledge of God's Word, remain steadfast in our faith and faithfully serve Him in all that we do. May the Lord strengthen us, unite us and make us a blessing to our generation and those to come. Amen."
